guides.definition: URLSearchParams represents the ordered query parameter list of a URL. get returns the first matching value or null.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The binding that receives the query value.

parameters.name: fallback
parameters.description: The value used when the parameter is absent.

examples.title: Read a mode parameter
examples.explanation: The current query string is parsed according to URL rules and a missing mode receives an explicit fallback.
